GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-10-20T17:37:41Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Parsing Request Accept header: why is Mvc not using Microsoft.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue?
Description: There seems to be a redundancy in the framework to parse accept headers request. 
On the one hand there's the type `AcceptHeaderParser `in `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Formatters `which we used to handle content negotiation, but it has recently been made internal so we had to find another solution.
On the other hand, there's `Microsoft.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue` , which also parses headers, but the results are a bit different, regarding the Quality property parsing. 
Which one are we supposed to use? We switched to `MediaTypeHeaderValue `because it's still public, but they seem to be redundant and do the same work, with some small differences... 
I notice that the `DefaultOutputFormatterSelector` is using the internal `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Formatters.AcceptHeaderParser` and I was wondering why there's not just one implementation to parse headers.
